coverages.description: Live coverage of the Cockroach Janta Party's protest movement — detentions, ultimatums, court cases, INDIA-bloc actions and on-ground developments in Delhi.
coverages.title: CJP Protest 2.0
coverages.current_summary: CJP's 24-hour ultimatum to Delhi Police expired on Oct 13 without protest permission; police instead registered an FIR against co-conveners Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka for alleged unauthorized trespass at Jantar Mantar and breach of their one-year peace bond, while the INDIA bloc escalated — Rahul Gandhi pledged to challenge Jantar Mantar's de-notification in court and proposed an early-November Ramlila Maidan rally with a symbolic 'impeach the CEC' move. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke is expected to reach Delhi on Oct 14.

coverages.description: Live coverage of the Houthi-Saudi escalation — missile and drone strikes on Riyadh and oil sites, airport and airspace closures, Saudi/coalition retaliation, US moves and diplomatic developments.
coverages.title: Houthi-Riyadh Escalation
coverages.current_summary: The Saudi-led coalition ordered a Sanaa fuel-site evacuation on Oct 13 ahead of a new operation and says it downed three drones over northern Riyadh on Tuesday; Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree threatened Riyadh retaliation and warned Aramco staff to evacuate. Coalition airstrikes on Al-Jawf killed 9 civilians including 5 children, and King Khalid airport remains closed till Oct 17.

coverages.description: Live coverage of the Russia-Ukraine war focused on the 'Energy Ceasefire' — strikes on energy infrastructure by either side, ceasefire claims and violations, Kremlin/White House/Kyiv statements, EU sanctions and oil-market fallout.
coverages.title: Russia-Ukraine War & Energy Ceasefire
coverages.current_summary: Trump's claimed 'energy ceasefire' remains unverified: Russia's Defence Ministry made its first claim of no energy targets hit overnight Oct 12-13, but Zelensky says Russia still used 100+ weapons and 4 people were killed in Kharkiv; Trump shrugged that 'they're both a little bit off.' France seized the suspected Russian shadow-fleet tanker DF Peak near Réunion — Moscow called it 'piracy' — while Germany and Canada rejected the US-brokered Russian diesel deal.

coverages.description: Live coverage of hurricane and tropical-storm activity impacting North America — NHC advisories, storm formation and intensity changes, watches and warnings, landfalls, casualties, damage and outage numbers, evacuations, closures and recovery.
coverages.location: North America (Atlantic basin, Gulf of Mexico, US Gulf/East coasts, Mexico's Pacific coast)
coverages.title: Hurricane Activity Impacting North America
coverages.current_summary: Tropical Depression Twenty-One-E formed off southern Mexico on Oct 13 (~35 mph, moving NW) and the NHC forecasts rapid intensification to a major hurricane by Friday; Hurricane Simon holds at Category 1 off Mexico's Pacific coast with warnings downgraded, and Puerto Vallarta airport reopened. No active Atlantic cyclones after the Cabo Verde disturbance fizzled.

coverages.title: U.S.–Iran Conflict & Strait of Hormuz
coverages.description: Live coverage of the U.S.–Iran confrontation — military posturing, strikes or threats, Strait of Hormuz shipping incidents and closure threats, Iranian statements, US administration moves, oil-market and diplomatic fallout.
coverages.current_summary: Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks escalated Oct 11-13: UKMTO documented six vessels struck on Oct 11 alone — the war's highest single-day total — plus a new Tuesday projectile strike off Khasab with the fire out and crew safe; Iran's Navy claimed a 'violating' tanker caught fire east of the strait. The UK blamed the IRGC for the RAF Fairford drone plot with 29 nations backing the attribution, while Trump claimed all 159 Iranian naval vessels were sunk and said the war 'will end very soon'; Brent holds near $105-106.
